description: AI agents of Primula Studio: command-line tools that receive the prompt and return an answer (File -> Settings -> AI tool). Built in; the user file (~/.config/primula-docs/agents.json, the same format) adds agents or replaces a built-in one with the same id. Fields: id (a-z, 0-9, -, _); name (shown in Settings); label (history marker of the answers); program (name in PATH or a path; File -> Settings overrides it); arguments (a list, one item per argument); skillArguments - flags with values that replace the same flags of arguments (or are added) when the request lets the agent load the skill primula-docs; prompt: stdin (the prompt is written to stdin) or arg (the item {prompt} of arguments is replaced by the prompt); output.format: text (stdout as is), json (one JSON object; with several lines the last one), jsonl (one event per line). output.field - the dotted path of the answer text in the object or event (item.text); output.ok - fields that must have these values when present, otherwise the answer is an error; output.errorField - the path of the error text; output.match - fields that choose the event of jsonl (the last such event is the answer); output.errorMatch/errorField - the events that carry an error (jsonl); output.textFallback - a stdout that is not JSON is the answer. Every agent must run read-only: it must not change files and run commands (see studio/tools/check_ai_agent.py).
